question_or_symptom: The source-freeze verifier makes the checkpoint repository set and current child heads exactly equal to the six immutable upstream entries in SOURCE_LOCK.
observation: That equality is correct for CP-0002, but it would reject a new self-amdgpu-runtime gitlink as unregistered and would reject every audited descendant commit in gem5, Triton, PyTorch, or vLLM because its current head differs from the frozen baseline head.
conclusion: Immutable source provenance and an evolving workspace project registry have different ownership and lifecycle rules.
decision: Make P0-SELF-01 first introduce a tracked authored-lane registry. SOURCE_LOCK and the registry authorize immutable baseline identity; checkpoints authorize exact current head/tree and require the head to descend from its baseline. The .gitmodules set must equal the union of upstream and authored lanes before self-amdgpu-runtime is published as a root gitlink.
invalidated_assumptions: The immutable upstream source lock can permanently serve as both the complete project registry and the current-head registry.
